api.onStreamData.note: Per-request template channel written in the preload as `api:stream:${requestId}:data`. It belongs to the api:stream invoke machinery, which `02` denies at tier N (generic outbound HTTP proxy); the per-request stream events are not listed in `02` v1.0.0 and are covered by the EVENT_ALLOWLIST `api:stream:` prefix at tier N pending a change request.

api.onStreamDone.note: Per-request template channel written in the preload as `api:stream:${requestId}:done`. Same provenance and N tier as api.onStreamData; see scripts/ipc-contract-overrides.json and the `api:stream:` event prefix in src/main/gateway/allowlist.ts.

api.onStreamError.note: Per-request template channel written in the preload as `api:stream:${requestId}:error`. Same provenance and N tier as api.onStreamData; see scripts/ipc-contract-overrides.json and the `api:stream:` event prefix in src/main/gateway/allowlist.ts.

api.onStreamAbort.note: Per-request template channel written in the preload as `api:stream:${requestId}:abort`. Same provenance and N tier as api.onStreamData; see scripts/ipc-contract-overrides.json and the `api:stream:` event prefix in src/main/gateway/allowlist.ts.
